news.headline: Chip Stocks Selloff Deepens: Micron -6%, AMD -7%, Nvidia -2.9% — Indian IT Rallies 4% via Rotation
news.what_happened: US semiconductors sold off sharply as investors trimmed AI hardware exposure ahead of Nvidia earnings (due Wednesday). Micron fell 6% on Netlist patent headwinds; AMD dropped 7%+. Iran sanctions ('Operation Economic Outcast') added macro overhang. Nasdaq -0.77% on Monday.
news.why_it_matters: Asian chip stocks continue falling on Tuesday (Kospi -2.37%, Nikkei -0.55%). However, Indian IT is RALLYING — investors rotating into asset-light Indian software services firms amid easing valuation concerns and ahead of US Fed's policy decision. Nifty IT surged ~4% during the chip selloff.

news.headline: Gold at $4,709/oz — Muthoot Finance Surged 6.19% Monday on Safe-Haven Demand
news.what_happened: Gold rose to $4,708.90/oz (+0.24%) as US-Iran tensions drive safe-haven demand. Domestic gold near Rs 1.63 lakh per 10g. Muthoot Finance jumped 6.19% Monday to Rs 3,209. Manappuram also gained 3-5%.
news.why_it_matters: Higher gold prices directly boost gold loan NBFC collateral values, enabling larger disbursals, reducing LTV credit risk, and improving NIM. With global uncertainty persisting (Nvidia earnings, Iran tensions), gold's safe-haven bid is likely to continue.

news.headline: Crude Oil +0.88% to $85.76 — Iran Tensions Keep Strait of Hormuz Risk Elevated
news.what_happened: WTI Crude rebounding to $85.76 after Monday's volatile session. US announced new Iran sanctions ('Operation Economic Outcast'). Brent Crude at $92.79, near 1-month high. Crude fell ~2.15% on Monday before partial recovery.
news.why_it_matters: Rising crude widens India's current account deficit, pressures INR, and adds inflation risk — keeping RBI hawkish. Directly hurts airlines (jet fuel 35-40% OPEX), paints, tyres, and logistics operators. Positive for upstream oil producers.

news.headline: US 10Y Yield Falls to 4.704% (-0.72%) — Fed Easing Expectations Build
news.what_happened: US 10-year treasury yield fell 0.72% to 4.704%. Bond markets are pricing in potential Federal Reserve easing as macro data softens. Dollar Index near flat at 99.01 (+0.01%).
news.why_it_matters: Falling US yields are supportive of EM capital flows back to India. Mildly positive for Indian rate-sensitive sectors (banks, NBFCs, real estate), though RBI remains on hold at 5.25% with neutral stance (next MPC meeting Oct 5-7).

news.headline: Asian Markets Weak; India VIX +2.90% — Range-Bound Open Expected for NSE
news.what_happened: MSCI Asia Pacific gauge slipped ~0.5% on Tuesday. Kospi (South Korea) fell 2.37% on chip stock rout. Nikkei -0.55% at open. Hang Seng -0.19%. China CSI 300 -0.44% on weak Q2 GDP (4.3%, below expectations). India VIX jumped 2.90%.
news.why_it_matters: Broad Asian weakness combined with elevated India VIX signals caution. GIFT Nifty at -0.13% indicates Nifty 50 to open near flat to mildly negative. Avoid aggressive entries at open. Today is not expiry day (Thursday is weekly options expiry).
